================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO EYA AFTER EFFECTS - EBIPYA
Version 9.2.8  -  Okitobba 2026
================================================================================

Panel kaakano eyogera ENNIMI 132, waliwo THEMES ZA DEMON SLAYER ezipya ez'ekitala
ekitema buttons ze onyiga, n'okutereeza kutono okwa layout ne Windows.

NGA TONNABA KUTANDIKA
- Teeka waggulu ku version yo eriwo ng'okozesa ZXP installer yo eya bulijjo,
  oluvannyuma ddamu otandike After Effects omulundi gumu.
- Enteekateeka zo, theme, presets ne expressions z'otereka bisigala.

EKIPYA: PANEL MU NNIMI 132
- Flex Enteekateeka > OLULIMI kaakano eraga ennimi 132, nga erina ekifo ky'okunoonya.
  Londa olulimi lumu era panel yonna ekyuka: tabs, buttons, tooltips, obubaka.
- Buli lulimi lwavvuunulwa nga bakozesa AI okuva ku panel y'Oluzungu, si kigambo ku
  kigambo. Amannya g'olaba mu project yo (amannya ga layers, ga effects) gasigala
  mu Luzungu bikwatagane ne After Effects.
- Popup eya "ebipya" nayo yavvuunulwa, okuva ku release eno.

EKIPYA: THEMES ZA DEMON SLAYER
- Flex Enteekateeka > THEME SELECTOR erina group empya eya DEMON SLAYER erimu themes 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen ne Kokushibo.
- Tambuza mouse ku panel era ekintu kya theme kigigoberera: amazzi, omuliro,
  okumyansa kw'eggulu, ebiwojjolo, ebikoola by'ebimuli, ekire n'ebirala. Mouse
  bw'eyimirira, kibula mpolampola.
- Nyiga button era ekitala kya character oyo kigitema. Weeyongere okunyiga button
  ey'ekkono era kigenda mu maaso n'okutema; gikwate okumala sekondi nga 2.5 era kibwatuka.
- Kikoleddwa okusigala nga kyangu: effects zikola kyokka ng'otambuza oba ng'onyiga, era
  ku kompyuta ezirina sipiidi entono zeyongera okuba ennyangu zokka. Ggyako EFFECTS
  Z'OBUTONDE mu Theme Selector osigaze langi zokka.

EKIKYUSIDDWA: BUTTONS ZA FLAT MU BULI THEME
- Buttons eza active n'enkulu mu themes eza langi tezikyakozesa gradient erina
  ekisiikirize okuva waggulu okukka wansi. Ziri langi emu eya flat nga zirina okwaka
  okugonvu, bwe zityo ziba nnongoofu era nga zisomeka bulungi.

EBITEREEZEDDWA
- Kaadi ya license ne popup eya "ebipya" byasobola okuggulwa kimu waggulu w'ekirala.
  Kaakano tebikyabikkaganako, era badge ya UPDATE tekyabikka buttons eziri
  waggulu ku panel.
- Ku UI SCALE 125% ne 150%, windows ezimu (nga Flex Enteekateeka) zasobola okuwanvuwa
  okusinga panel, kale button yaazo ey'okuggalawo n'efuluma mu kulaba. Kaakano buli
  window esaanira bulungi ku buli bunene.
- Windows: AutoCaptions yasobola okulaga "NVIDIA DRIVER YA DDA NNYO KU GPU
  CAPTIONS" ku cards ne drivers empya (RTX 40 ne 50 series). Kaakano esoma bulungi
  CUDA support ya driver era ekozesa GPU yo.

EBITAKYUSIDDWA
- License, activation ne links zonna bikola ddala nga bwe byali.
- Tabs n'ebikozesebwa ebirala byonna bikola ddala nga mu 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE EYA PREMIERE PRO - EBIPYA
Version 2.2.8  -  Okitobba 2026

CAPTION STACK captions kati ze templates za Motion Graphics EZIRONGOOSEBWA nga zirina
editor entuufu, waliwo AUDIO STUDIO empya ne KUMAKO AUDIO BEATS, panel eyogera
ENNIMI 132, UI SCALE etuuse mu ULTIMATE, era waliwo THEMES ZA DEMON SLAYER ezipya.

NGA TONNABA KUTANDIKA
- Teeka waggulu ku version yo eriwo ng'okozesa ZXP installer yo eya bulijjo,
  oluvannyuma ddamu otandike Premiere Pro omulundi gumu.
- Enteekateeka zo, theme ne presets bisigala.

EKIPYA: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS EZIRONGOOSEBWA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Captions kati ziteekebwa nga templates za Motion Graphics ezirongoosebwa (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, default empya mu Premiere Pro 2026). Nga zimaze okuteekebwa,
  osobola okukyusa ekigambo kyonna, font, langi, obunene, ekifo, glow, outline, box,
  animation oba ekiseera mu Essential Graphics panel ya Premiere.
- Output > EBIFAANANYI bikyateeka buli kigambo ng'ekifaananyi ekirina endabika y'ennyini,
  bw'oba oyagala ekyo.
- Templates ziri wamu ne panel. Tewali kya kuwanula.

EKIPYA: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview kati eraga frame entuufu eya vidiyo yo wansi wa buli caption.
- Sika caption okugitambuza, kozesa ensonda okukyusa obunene n'akabonero akali waggulu
  okugikyusa, nyiga emirundi ebiri ku kigambo okukirongoosa. CAPTION YONNA etambuza
  ebigambo byonna wamu, EKIGAMBO KIMU etambuza ekigambo kimu.
- Londa oba enkyukakyuka ekola ku captions zonna oba ku caption eno yokka, era
  tereka layouts zo okuzikozesa nate.
- Endabika empya 10 eza GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow ne Superb.

EKIPYA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Londa audio clip, londa effect, onyige KOZESA. Buli kimu kikola ku kompyuta
  yo.
- Presets 30 ez'okunyiga omulundi gumu: Wansi w'amazzi, Bass Boost, reverb ya Room / Hall /
  Cathedral / Plate, Echo, Essimu, Leediyo, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse n'ebirala. Gattika
  effects nga bw'oyagala, kyusa ennyiriri yaazo oba ggyako emu.
- Reverb ekuuma omukira gwayo: eddoboozi likyawulirwa ne clip ng'ewedde, era liteekebwa
  mu ngeri etakyusa kintu kyonna ku timeline yo.
- Ebikozesebwa: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Sipiidi
  ne Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER ekutulamu oluyimba mu ddoboozi n'ennyimba (oba stems 4). Ewanula model
  yaayo omulundi ogusooka era esooka kukubuuza.
- PREVIEW ekuleka owulire sekondi nga 8 ng'okozesa switch eya Original / Processed.
  Ebivuddemu bigenda ku audio track ey'obwereere ne clip yo eyasooka esirisibwa,
  tesangulwa.

EKIPYA: KUMAKO AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > KUMAKO AUDIO BEATS)
- Londa clip y'omuziki ku timeline onyige KUMAKO BEATS: Flex ezuula beats era
  eziteekako markers za sequence, bwe kityo cuts zo zikwatagana bulungi
  n'omuziki.
- Londa HITS ZONNA, KICKS oba SNARES, teekawo sensitivity, era kuma buli beat oba
  buli beat ey'okubiri oba ey'okuna.
- GGYAWO BEAT MARKERS esangula markers Flex ze yateekawo zokka. Ekola ku
  kompyuta yo.

EKIPYA: PANEL MU NNIMI 132
- Enteekateeka > OLULIMI kaakano eraga ennimi 132, nga erina ekifo ky'okunoonya. Tabs,
  buttons, tooltips n'obubaka byonna bikyuka. Popup eya "ebipya" nayo yavvuunulwa,
  okuva ku release eno.

EKIPYA: UI SCALE
- Enteekateeka > UI SCALE ekola panel yonna okuba ennene oba entono, nga mu
